subject.title: feat(chat): restore prompt image attachments on rewind/fork

question: Should rewind and fork continue to replace the composer wholesale when that can discard an attachment staged during the short request round-trip?
rationale: The implementation intentionally chooses a cross-platform session-state contract rather than a mechanical bug fix: preserving concurrent attachment edits would require revision or merge semantics across web, Swift, and Android composers.

options.title: Accept whole-composer replacement
options.body: Land the documented replacement semantics so rewind and fork restore the selected prompt's text and images as one coherent composer state.

options.title: Require concurrent-draft preservation
options.body: Pause this PR and define cross-client revision or merge behavior that preserves attachments staged after the rewind or fork begins.

recommendation.title: Accept whole-composer replacement
recommendation.body: Land the documented replacement semantics so rewind and fork restore the selected prompt's text and images as one coherent composer state.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent implementation and its documented tradeoff span the affected gateway and client paths.
